Our Approach

A home is a body. Its mechanical systems are its vital organs.

Plumbing and heating are its circulatory system. HVAC is its lungs. Like your health, the systems that keep a property alive last longer with regular, preventative care than with emergency repairs — and that is exactly how we work.

01
Circulatory — Plumbing & HeatingWater and heat move through a home like blood. We keep the flow clean, warm and uninterrupted.
02
Respiratory — HVAC & AirEvery breath a building takes runs through its HVAC. We keep the air clean, balanced and efficient.
03
Structure — Hydronics & Building SystemsThe framework that holds it together — engineered, maintained and future-proofed.

The Maintenance Program

One membership. Your whole property, maintained.

You’re either on the Leader Service maintenance program or you’re not — no tiers to compare, no packages to decode. We walk your property, scope the exact systems that need care, and set one straightforward price based on what you actually have.

Like your health, the systems that keep a property running last longer with regular care than with emergency repairs. Every visit is documented, so you always have a clear record of what’s been done — and what’s coming up.

Book a walkthrough

How it works

A Leader specialist sets your program in four steps — most start with a single walkthrough.

01
Property walkthroughWe inventory every mechanical system and note its age, condition and the interval it should be serviced on.
02
Scoped to your propertyWe set exactly what gets maintained, and how often — based on your real systems, not a package tier.
03
One flat, transparent pricePriced on the systems you have. Billed annually or monthly — your choice, same price either way.
04
Ongoing digital recordEvery visit documented in your portal, so your service history is always at hand.

Two service windows a year — spring and fall — with every system serviced at its own correct interval, never a generic “two visits” schedule.

Technology, working for you

Powered by technology.
Delivered by people.

The smart systems behind Leader Service exist for one reason — to get a real technician to your door faster, better prepared, and easier to deal with.

Faster when it counts

Your call gets answered and the right specialist routed to you quickly — with true emergencies pushed to the front of the line, day or night.

Technicians who arrive ready

Your property’s full service history and system details are in hand before they knock, so problems get solved right the first time — fewer repeat visits.

Straight answers, no upsell

Clear guidance on what your property actually needs — and what it doesn’t. You get an honest recommendation, not a sales pitch.

Pricing up front

Transparent quotes and approvals sent to your phone before any work begins. You know the price first — no surprise invoices.

Small issues caught early

We keep an eye on the health of your systems, so the little things get flagged and handled before they turn into an expensive emergency.

Your records, always handy

Every visit is documented digitally — what we checked, what we did, what’s next — so your service history is a tap away whenever you need it.

The technology stays behind the scenes. When it matters, a Leader technician — a real person you can reach — is the one at your door.

Privacy Policy

Last updated September 8, 2026

Leader Service (Leader Service Group Canada Inc.) respects your privacy. This policy explains what information we collect when you contact us, book service, or receive messages from us, how we use it, and the choices you have.

Information we collect

When you contact us or request service we collect your name, phone number, service address, email address, and details about the work you need. When you pay for service we collect billing information through our payment processor. When you agree to receive text messages we also collect your mobile number and a record of your consent.

How we use your information

We use your information to schedule and perform service, send appointment confirmations and reminders, dispatch and arrival notifications, quotes, approvals, invoices and payment links, follow up after service, administer maintenance plans, and — where you have separately agreed — send occasional promotions.

Text messaging (SMS/MMS)

What we collect

When you give us your mobile number and agree to receive text messages, we collect the number, a record of your consent (the date and time, the page it was given on, and the disclosure text you were shown), and the content and delivery status of messages exchanged with us.

How we use it

We use your mobile number to confirm and remind you about appointments, tell you when a technician is on the way, send quotes, approvals, invoices and payment links, follow up after service, notify you about maintenance plan renewals, and — where you have separately agreed to marketing messages — send occasional promotions.

Sharing

No mobile information will be shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes. Text messaging originator opt-in data and consent are excluded from all other data sharing; this information will not be shared with any third parties. We use service providers to operate the program on our behalf — including our field service platform and our messaging carrier — and they may process your number only to deliver the messages we send, under contract, and for no other purpose. We do not sell your personal information.

Your right to opt out

You can stop receiving text messages at any time by replying STOP to any message from us. You will receive one confirmation message and nothing further. You may also call us at 905.264.1162 or email info@ldrservice.com to be removed. Opting out of text messages does not cancel a scheduled appointment or a maintenance plan, and does not stop us from contacting you by phone or email about work in progress.

Getting help

Reply HELP to any message, or contact us using the details below.

How long we keep it

We retain consent and opt-out records for as long as you remain a customer and for a period afterward as required to demonstrate compliance with telecommunications regulations.

Data retention & security

We keep your information for as long as needed to provide service and meet our legal and regulatory obligations, and we take reasonable measures to protect it.

Cookies and tracking

This website does not use advertising or analytics tracking cookies, and we do not sell or share your information with advertisers or data brokers. We use only the storage strictly necessary for the site to function. Because we do not use non-essential tracking, we do not display a cookie-consent banner.

Payments

We do not take payments through this website. Pricing, cancellation and refund terms for any service are set out in the written estimate and invoice we provide to you directly.

SMS Terms & Conditions

Last updated September 8, 2026

1. About this program

Leader Service (Leader Service Group Canada Inc., 132 Corstate Avenue, Unit 100, Concord, ON L4K 4X2) sends text messages to customers and prospective customers who have given us their mobile number and agreed to receive them. By opting in, you agree to these terms.

2. Messages you can expect

Appointment confirmations and reminders; technician dispatch and arrival notifications; quotes, estimates and approval requests; invoices, payment links and receipts; maintenance plan and membership renewal reminders; service follow-ups and review requests; emergency and after-hours service updates; and, if you have agreed to marketing messages, occasional promotions and seasonal offers.

3. Message frequency

Message frequency varies with your activity — typically two to five messages per scheduled appointment, and no more than four promotional messages per month.

4. Cost

Message and data rates may apply. Leader Service does not charge you for these messages; your mobile carrier’s standard messaging and data rates apply.

5. How to stop

Reply STOP to any message from us to unsubscribe. You will receive one confirmation message and no further texts. You may also call 905.264.1162 or email info@ldrservice.com. Opting out of text messages does not cancel a scheduled appointment or a maintenance plan, and we may still contact you by phone or email about work in progress.

6. How to get help

Reply HELP to any message for assistance, or contact us at 905.264.1162, info@ldrservice.com, or 132 Corstate Avenue, Unit 100, Concord, ON L4K 4X2. Customer care is available Monday to Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 6:00 p.m., with emergency service available 24/7.

7. Eligibility

You must be at least 18 years old and the account holder or an authorized user of the mobile number you provide. Tell us right away if that number changes or is no longer yours.

8. Consent is not a condition of purchase

You do not have to agree to receive text messages in order to book service, request a quote, or purchase any goods or services from Leader Service.

9. Carriers

Mobile carriers are not liable for delayed or undelivered messages. Delivery is subject to effective transmission by your carrier and is not guaranteed.

10. Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. The current version is always posted on this page, and the date above shows when it last changed.

11. Privacy

Your mobile number and consent record are handled as described in our Privacy Policy. No mobile information is shared with third parties or affiliates for marketing or promotional purposes.
